sources.title: Oversold ETF bounce idea
sources.claim_summary: Buying a liquid ETF after a low RSI reading may capture a short rebound.

hypothesis: A liquid ETF with an unusually low RSI may experience short-horizon mean reversion.
entry_rule: Buy at the next open when RSI(14) is below 30.
exit_rule: Sell at the close when RSI(14) returns above 50 or after ten sessions.
sizing_rule: Allocate equal capital to qualifying ETFs, capped at 25 percent per instrument.
ambiguities: The source does not define a universe or whether RSI uses adjusted or raw prices.
